question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the idiom from the options given below.

To show the white feather
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. **To act cowardly**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"to show the white feather"** is commonly used to refer to someone acting in a cowardly manner or showing fear in a situation. (डरपोक होने का संकेत देना)

 
 
• **Example:** Despite his big talk, he showed the white feather when it was time to confront the challenge.
 
 
 
• **"Cowardly"** means lacking courage to face danger, difficulty, or opposition. (कायरतापूर्ण)
 
 
• **Example:** His cowardly behavior during the crisis disappointed everyone.
 
 
 
• Hence, the idiom "to show the white feather" appropriately means "to act cowardly."

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. **To act cowardly**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 2: To show anger** (गुस्सा दिखाना): Refers to expressing rage or annoyance.

 
 
• **Example:** He showed anger when he found out about the mistake in the project.
 
 
 
• **Option 3: To maintain peace** (शांति बनाए रखना): Refers to ensuring calmness and avoiding conflict.
 
 
• **Example:** The leader urged the crowd to maintain peace during the protest.
 
 
 
• **Option 4: To act bravely** (साहसी तरीके से कार्य करना): Refers to showing courage in a difficult situation.
 
 
• **Example:** The firefighter acted bravely to save the family from the burning house.
